svg.aria-label: How Screencast Director drafts the edit. When you stop recording, whisper.cpp transcribes your voice on your Mac, and the app lines that transcript up with a log of when you clicked and typed, never what you typed. Then the talking rule decides every stretch: talking plays in real time, typing without talking fast-forwards, and nothing happening gets cut. The draft edit is a timeline of real-time clips, sped-up clips and cuts, with zooms where you clicked and captions from what you said. On one demo, a 3:36 recording came out at 2:56.
